explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` and `next_token()` to walk the fragment in document order, appending only ordinary `#text` tokens plus opener-carried text from `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA` via `get_modifiable_text()`. I then truncated the decoded UTF-8 result by Unicode code points with `mb_strlen`/`mb_substr`, with a UTF-8 regex fallback if mbstring is unavailable.
